description: Reads a raw storage slot of any contract, decoded as hex, integer and address. How you inspect proxy implementation slots, owners and paused flags that have no public getter. Via eth_getStorageAt. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

slot.description: Slot number in decimal, or a 0x slot key such as an EIP-1967 hash.

name: evm_storage
title: Raw contract storage
